period_page_source.facts: Changing grove groundspawn positions, five dated location reports; not a fixed single spawn.

core_semantics.facts: Constructor and Object::RandomSpawn were read. RandomSpawn changes XY on every respawn, but only computes missing Z once and does not call FixZ. Constructor invokes FixZ only for fix_z0. Thus a sloping random rectangle with one Z can float/bury on subsequent respawns; bounded fixed points with fix_z1 preserve each selected explicit floor.

REA: Reused retained unsupported-EQG evidence and pinned EQEmu zone-utilities-derived parser; no shared target/session opened. CRC/inflate lengths, full terrain cursor and full static mesh cursor validated.
privacy: No proprietary member bytes or images copied into a public package; all expanded inventory/geometry stays private.
